capital.evidence_quote: Dili is the capital, primary commercial center, and chief port of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste

currency.evidence_quote: The United States Dollar (USD) is the official currency; centavo coins are minted locally for change

sources.title: Direcção Nacional de Meteorologia e Geofísica

timezone.evidence_quote: Timor-Leste Time operates year-round on UTC+9 with no daylight saving time adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Timor-Leste is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national electrical grid is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European Type C and F two-pin sockets and Australian Type I sockets are both encountered

police.evidence_quote: Dial 112 for emergency police response throughout Timor-Leste

sources.title: Hospital Nacional Guido Valadares (HNGV) Emergency Ambulance

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 110 for emergency medical services and national ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 115 for emergency fire and rescue services

sources.title: Ministry of Tourism, Commerce and Industry Timor-Leste

tourist_police.evidence_quote: National tourism information office in Dili operates at +670 333 1120

advisory_headline.tr: Doğu Timor Güneydoğu Asya'nın en el değmemiş ve huzurlu ülkelerindendir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Timor-Leste is very peaceful and scenic; exercise normal travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Osttimor ist ein sicheres und noch unberührtes Reiseland; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Восточный Тимор — спокойное и аутентичное государство; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: Timor Oriental es un destino sumamente pacífico y prístino; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Timor-Leste reach approximately 25.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Dili measure 35.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Telemor (Viettel), Timor Telecom, and Telkomcel provide 4G SIMs at Presidente Nicolau Lobato International Airport (DIL). Visa on Arrival is $30 USD in cash at Dili airport.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid cellular registration requires valid passport verification

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 97% of population; Asia's most Catholic nation alongside the Philippines)
religion.evidence_quote: Roman Catholicism is deeply embraced alongside indigenous animist lulik traditions and sacred houses (uma lulik)

festivals.value: Restoration of Independence Day (May 20), Popular Consultation Day (August 30), Dili International Marathon, Santa Cruz Day
festivals.evidence_quote: May 20 Restoration of Independence is celebrated with parades and cultural performances nationwide

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Respect sacred traditional houses (uma lulik) and ancestral totems; never enter without community elders' invitation. Crocodiles (lafaek) are revered as sacred ancestral creators in Timorese mythology; heed beach crocodile warning flags strictly. Tetum and Portuguese are official.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Saltwater crocodiles hold sacred status in local myth; observe cautionary signs on northern beaches

tipping.value: Tipping is not traditional in Timor-Leste, but leaving 5-10% in hotel dining or rounding up taxi fares is appreciated.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is not customary but small tips for good service are welcomed
